config.notes: Full supplementary absolute grid declared after observing only component distance distributions: quantile-based pusher-close levels45.7/66.6/98.1 were relatively loose. This supplement tests10/20/40-world-unit radii and 2/5/10-degree angular radii; all57 conditions and all simulations are kept. It does not replace the original quantile analysis or tune a policy. No training, validation/test state candidates, or action labels are used.

pair_count_convention: Symmetric conditions count unordered distinct-frame pairs once; ordered pairs are twice this. Top-k relations and per-anchor candidate degrees are directed.
array_storage_note: Float64 distance computation, float32 RAM matrices; no dense matrix saved.

threshold_calibration.population: fixed absolute physical sensitivity grid; no state-label fitting
threshold_calibration.selection_reason: Supplement declared after component distribution inspection, before reviewing candidate/simulation statistics.

interpretation_limits: Thresholds are fixed absolute sensitivity criteria, not optimized action-compatibility tolerances.
Frame-uniform anchors and pair counts give longer episodes more weight.
Partial batches are reported, never padded into successful batches.
